s: Sukka venoyah asurin kol shiba ubo k"a seipim: keshem shechal shem shamayim al haqqodashim, ulekak hen asurim bahanaa — kak chal shem shamayim al hassukka, shenneemar "chag hassukkot shibat yamim laHashem", ma chag dehaynu chagiga laHashem — ap sukka laHashem. Veen niqra sukka ella hassekak bilbad, lepikak asur lehistappeq meatze hassekak kol shibat yeme hechag min hattora, ben mehassekak hatztzarik leheksher sukka, dehaynu z' tepachim al z' tepachim, ben mehassekak hayyater al heksher sukka. Vaapillu nopla hassukka venitbattela mitzvatah — ap al pi ken asur lehistappeq meatze hassekak kol shibat yeme hechag min hattora:

Umiddibre soperim asur lehistappeq apillu meatze haddepanot kol shibat yeme hechag, apillu im nopla hassukka, veap al pi shehaddepanot enan iqqar hassukka, mikkol maqom hoil vehuqtzu lemitzvat sukka — chal alehem qedushshat hassukka leheaser bahanaa kemotah. Vaapillu haddepanot sheen tzarik leheksher sukka, kegon sheasa arba depanot shelemot, im asa arbatan bistam, shello peresh al ezeh dopen kavvanato leheksher sukka veal ezeh dopen kavvanato laasoto dopen rebii lemitzva min hammubchar beolma — hare kol haddepanot muqtzot lemitzvat hassukka vechal alehem qedushshat hassukka. Abal im leachar sheasa min haddepanot shiur hatztzarik leheksher sukka hosip od dopen, shennireh mikkavvanato baasiyyat zeh haddopen sheeno ella lemitzva min hammubchar beolma — lo neesar kelal zeh haddopen velo chala alayv qedushshat hassukka meolam*veayyen besiman trs"z sham nitbaer deben atze hassekak uben atze haddepanot uben noy hassukka asurin gam bishmini atzeret beeretz yisrael, ubechutz laaretz asurim ap batteshii, ayyen sham hattaam.:

Im leachar shessikkek kol sekak hatztzarik lesukkato hosip alayv od qanim boobi hassekak — hare qanim ellu shehosip hen betelim legabbe hassekak vechal alehen qedushshat hassukka. Abal im hinniach al hassekak chabilot shel qanim mequshsharim, kevan shello hittir agadan — nikkar haddabar sheeno mitkavven alehem lesikkuk, shehare derek haolam shekkol hamsakkek beqanim hu mattir agadan, vezeh shello hittir nikkar haddabar sheeno mitkavven bahen lehosip boobi hassekak, ulepikak enan betelim legabbe hassekak velo chala alehem qedushshat hassukka:

Abal im hosip qanim boobi haddepanot, dehaynu shezzaqap qanim etzel haddopen samuk laddopen, ben shehaqqanim hen agudim yachad keen chabila, ben shehen meporadin zeh mizzeh, im nitkavven bismikat haqqanim laddopen kede lechazzeq et haddopen o kede lehosip beobyo — hare hen betelim legabbe haddopen ap al pi sheenan mechubbarin laddopen, vechal alehem qedushshat hassukka kemo al haddopen atzmo:

Vaapillu atze hassekak vehaddepanot atzman enan asurim ella lehistappeq mehen, dehaynu shello yittol mehen shum dabar, apillu qesam lachtzotz bo shinnayv, shehare keshemmaprid haqqesam mehassukka mapqia hu mealayv qedushshat hassukka. Abal muttar lehanot mehen hanaa lehishtammesh bahem kol tashmish kol sheeno mapqia mealehem qedushshat hassukka, kegon lehanniach alehem chapatzayv, ulehariach bahem im hem atze besamim, vekol kayyotze bazeh:

Noye hassukka, dehaynu mine perot umine megadim shettolim bassukka kede lenaotah, ben shehen tachat hassekak, ben shehen sebib haddepanot — asur lehistappeq mehem kol yeme hechag, vaapillu im napelu mehassukka, mippene shehu bizzuy lammitzva keshemmistappeq minnoyah. Vekevan shehen asurin baakila — asurin gam betiltul beshabbat veyom tob, shehare enan reuyim liklum kol yeme hechag, vaapillu mippene haggannabim o mippene haggeshamim asurim letaltelam:

Veim hitna alehem meereb yom tob qodem kenisat yom tob, dehaynu qodem ben hashshemashot, veamar en ani bodel millehistappeq mehem kol shehut orek ben hashshemashot shel kol shemonat hayyamim, venimtza beshaa shehayeta haqqedushsha tzerika lachul alehem, dehaynu beben hashshemashot shehi techillat kenisat hayyom, beshaa zo lo chala alehem kelal, shehare hitna alehem sheyyihyeh kocho uzekuto bahem, veim ken lo huqtzu kelal lemitzva, ulepikak muttar lehistappeq mehem bekol hechag ematay sheyyirtzeh, veap al pi shehen teluyim bassukka — en bazeh mishshum bizzuy mitzva, kevan shello huqtzu kelal lemitzva:

Abal im eno matneh alehem belashon zeh shebbearnu, raq omer ani matneh alehem sheehe muttar lehistappeq mehem kesheyyippelu mehassukka — en tenay zeh moil kelum, shehare lo hitna ella al shaa shello yihyu teluyim bassukka, veim ken beben hashshemashot shehayu teluyim bassukka — chala alehen qedushshat hassukka, vekevan shechala — shub enah nipqaat al yede mah shehitna mittechilla, sheen tenay moil ella leshello tachul haqqedushsha, abal kevan shechala — shub enah nipqaat, ulepikak apillu im nopla mehassukka — asur lehistappeq mehem:

Veken im amar eni bodel mehem kol shehut orek ben hashshemashot shel yom harishon bilbad, velo hitna al ben hashshemashot shel shear hayyamim — asur lehistappeq mehem miyyom sheni vaelak, lepi shekkol yom vayom nechshab liqdushsha bipne atzmah vechala alehem haqqedushsha bitchillat kenisat kol yom shello hitna alayv. Veim hitna alehem sheeno bodel mehem kol shehut ben hashshemashot shemmiyyom sheni vaelak velo hitna al ben hashshemashot shel yom harishon — asur lehistappeq mehem apillu miyyom sheni vaelak, shekkevan shechala alehem haqqedushsha beben hashshemashot harishon — shub enah nipqaat kol yeme hechag, lepi shehen yom echad arok leinyan zeh lehachamir abal lo lehaqel. Abal im hitna veamar eni bodel mehen kol ben hashshemashot bistam, dehaynu shello hizkir beperush layyom harishon velo lishar yamim — hayeta kavvanato al ben hashshemashot shel kol yeme hechag, vahare zeh muttar lehistappeq mehen ematay sheyyirtzeh, ben bayyom harishon ben bishar yamim:

Veken im lo hizkir kelal ben hashshemashot, ella amar eni bodel et atzmi millehistappeq mehem bekol et sheertzeh — hare zeh mistappeq mehen ematay sheyyirtzeh, shekkevan shehitna lehistappeq mehen bekol et sheyyirtzeh — hare gam ben hashshemashot hu biklal hattenay, venimtza shello chala alehem haqqedushsha meolam:

Venahagu haolam shekkol dabar chashub tolin bassukka lenoy, kegon sedinin hamtzuyyarim vekayyotze bahen, umesirin otan min hassukka bekol et sheyyirtzu, kegon [mi]pene haggeshamim o [mi]pene haggannabim, apillu im lo hitna alehem meereb yom tob. Veyesh shennatenu taam lamminhag, dekevan shemminhag haolam lehasiran mehassukka mechamat chashash haggannabim o [mi]pene haggeshamim, im ken kol adam shettoleh debarim chashubim bassukka lenoy vadday en dato ella al derek hamminhag, dehaynu lehasiran mishsham beet hatztzorek, vahare zeh keillu hitna alehem beperush tenay hammoil lehasiran mishsham kesheyyitztarek, dehaynu sheeno bodel mehem kol shehut ben hashshemashot shel kol yeme hechag, ulepikak muttar lehasiran mishsham ematay sheyyirtzeh, vaapillu shello bishat haggeshem, vaapillu en sham chashash mehaggannabim, shehare lo chala alehem qedushshat hassukka meolam. Umikkol maqom, lekattechilla nakon haddabar lehatnot alehem meereb yom tob:

Vekol zeh benoye hassukka, abal atze hassekak atzmam — en moil lahem shum tenay lehistappeq mehen, apillu likshettippol hassukka betok shemonat yeme hechag, shehare issuran hu min hattora kemo shennitbaer lemala. Vaapillu atze haddepanot sheissuran eno ella middibre soperim, hoil vehuqtzu lemitzvat sukka chala alehem qedushshat hassukka — ap al pi ken en moil lahem hattenay lehistappeq mehen apillu likshettippol hassukka betok hechag, shehare kol sheeno matneh sheeno bodel mehen kol shehut shel ben hashshemashot — eno tenay kelal kemo shennitbaer, umeatze haddepanot al korcho hu tzarik lihyot mubdal mehen kol shehut ben hashshemashot shel yom harishon shehu yom tob, vei epshar lo littol shum dabar meatze haddepanot atzman mishshum setirat ohel beyom tob, veim ken beal korcho chala alehem haqqedushsha miyyom harishon, veshub enah nipqaat kol yeme hechag, apillu im nopla hassukka betok hechag:

Abal im leachar sheggamar asiyyat haddopen hosip beobyo qanim zequpim semukim laddopen kede lechazzeqo, veenan mechubbarin im haddopen beinyan shemmuttar littol qanim ellu mehaddopen beyom tob veen bazeh mishshum setirat ohel kevan sheenan mechubbarin lehaddopen, ukemo shennitbaer besiman tqy"ch, vehitna al qanim ellu tenay hammoil lehistappeq bekol et sheyyirtzeh veal derek shennitbaer — hare zeh mistappeq mehen bekol et sheyyirtzeh, shehare beben hashshemashot harishon haya yakol lehistappeq mehen, venimtza shello chala alehem qedushshat hassukka meolam:

Veim asa sukka bechol hammoed vehitna al atze haddepanot bitnay hammoil lehistappeq mehen bekol et sheyyirtzeh — hare zeh mistappeq mehen bekol et sheyyirtzeh, apillu beshaa shehassukka qayyemet veyosheb bah leshem mitzva, veen bazeh mishshum bizzuy mitzva, kevan shehaddepanot lo huqtzu kelal lammitzva, shehare hitna alehem mittechilla sheyyehe rashshay lehistappeq mehen, venimtza shello chala alehem qedushshat hassukka meolam:

Vekol issurim haellu shebbearnu besiman zeh nohagin apillu besukka shello naaset leshem mitzva, vaapillu lo chiddesh bah dabar, vehu sheyyashab bah paam achat leshem mitzvat sukka. Abal qodem sheyyashab bah leshem mitzvat sukka — en aleha qedushsha kelal, apillu asaah leshem mitzvat sukka, umuttar lehistappeq apillu meatze hassekak, veen tzarik lomar meatze haddepanot uminnoye hassukka, shekkol mitzva sheadayin lo nishtammeshu bah leshem mitzva — en aleha qedushsha kelal, kemo shennitbaer besiman m"b:

Vaapillu mi sheyyesh lo sukka benuya mishshana leshana, ap al pi sheyyashab bah beshana sheobra — ap al pi ken enah asura ad sheyyesheb bah bachag shel shana zo, dekevan sheabar hachag shel shana sheobra — botla qedushshat hassukka, veen haqqedushsha chala aleha ad sheyyesheb bah paam achat leshem mitzva:
Mi sherotzeh lehasir noye hassukka beyom tob mippene haggeshamim vehaggannabim — yizzaher shello yeqashsher hannoyin bassukka beqesher gamur, shehare asur lehattiran beyom tob, ella yaanbem:
Ap mi sheen dato lehasir hannoyin mehassukka kol yeme hechag, mikkol maqom im yodea shehayladim yoklu mehannoyin betok hechag — yatneh alehem meereb yom tob:

Atze hassekak achar sheaberu yeme hechag, ap al pi sheen tzarik legonzan umuttar lehistappeq mehen ulehishtammesh bahen lekol mah sheyyirtzeh, mikkol maqom nakon lizzaher shello lehishtammesh bahen tashmish bizzayon, sheenah kabod lammitzva sheobra, veen tzarik lomar sheen lipsoa alehem, shello yinhog bahem minhag bizzayon:

Otan anashim shechoqeqim pasuq "bassukkot teshebu ku'" al haddelaat vetolim bassukka lenoy — tzarik limchot beyadam, lepi sheasur liktob pesuqim min hattora ella im ken yesh bahem seper shalem kemo shennitbaer beyoreh dea siman rp"g, vachaqiqa hi kiktiba leinyan zeh:
En litlot shaatnez sebib haddepanot shel hassukka lenoy ella im ken hu lemala meraashotayv shel adam, mittaam shennitbaer beyoreh dea siman sh"a:
